messages.subject: Upcoming workshops, February 2015 in Zurich
parts:
Hi All,

I'll be presenting a two day workshop in February on the mirt and mirtCAT packages at the University of Zurich, Switzerland. In case you (or someone you know) are interested and in that part of the world, registration is available here: http://www.zhrcourses.uzh.ch/programm/datenanalyse/irt-analysis_en.html. I'll also be giving an introduction to R graphics course in the following week (http://www.zhrcourses.uzh.ch/programm/datenanalyse/intro-graph_en.html), and the same invitation applies. Cheers.

Phil
